messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **Canadian federal holidays** that create long‑weekends in 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the *observed* date is the following Monday, which is the day off.)

| Holiday | Calendar Date | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Dates (Sat–Mon) |
|---------|---------------|--------------------------|------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | 1 Jan 2023 (Sun) | 2 Jan 2023 (Mon) | 30 Dec 2022 – 2 Jan 2023 |
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, etc.) | 20 Feb 2023 (Mon) | — | 18 Feb 2023 – 20 Feb 2023 |
| Good Friday | 7 Apr 2023 (Fri) | — | 7 Apr 2023 – 9 Apr 2023 |
| Victoria Day | 22 May 2023 (Mon) | — | 20 May 2023 – 22 May 2023 |
| Canada Day | 1 Jul 2023 (Sat) | 3 Jul 2023 (Mon) | 1 Jul 2023 – 3 Jul 2023 |
| Labour Day | 4 Sep 2023 (Mon) | — | 2 Sep 2023 – 4 Sep 2023 |
| Thanksgiving | 9 Oct 2023 (Mon) | — | 7 Oct 2023 – 9 Oct 2023 |
| Remembrance Day | 11 Nov 2023 (Sat) | 13 Nov 2023 (Mon) | 11 Nov 2023 – 13 Nov 2023 |
| Christmas | 25 Dec 2023 (Mon) | — | 23 Dec 2023 – 25 Dec 2023 |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador).  
> • If you need province‑specific long‑weekends, let me know which provinces you’re interested in.
